claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The repository models supply-chain data as connected business objects with typed properties, relationships, read-only functions, governed actions, permissions, execution evidence, audit history, and safe AI-accessible tools.
claims.quote: This repository demonstrates how supply-chain data can be modeled as connected business objects with typed properties, relationships, read-only functions, governed actions, permissions, execution evidence, audit history, and safe AI-accessible tools.
